description: This file defines various Kubernetes-related data structures for output representations, including bootstrap tokens, images, upgrade plans, certificates, and expiration info, used in kubeadm commands.

classes.name: Images
classes.description: Represents output information for container images.

classes.name: ComponentUpgradePlan
classes.description: Contains upgrade plan details for a specific component.

classes.name: ComponentConfigVersionState
classes.description: Describes current and desired version states of a component configuration.

classes.name: AvailableUpgrade
classes.description: Details about an available upgrade including its components.

classes.name: UpgradePlan
classes.description: Represents the overall upgrade plan including available upgrades and config versions.

classes.name: Certificate
classes.description: Holds information about a certificate or CA, including expiration and management details.

classes.name: CertificateExpirationInfo
classes.description: Contains expiration information for certificates and CAs.
